name: System Network Discovery - Linux
description: Detects enumeration of local network configuration via common networking tools. Adapted from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_system_network_discovery.yml, hand-converted from Sigma (no ecs_linux/auditd pysigma pipeline exists).
query: any where process.executable like~ ("*/firewall-cmd", "*/ufw", "*/iptables", "*/netstat", "*/ss", "*/ip", "*/ifconfig", "*/systemd-resolve", "*/route") or process.title like~ "*/etc/resolv.conf*"
author: Sentinel
